Title: Why I Started Budgeting With a Coffee Cup Analogy
Summary: A simple way to think about spending without the spreadsheet anxiety.
Body:
Every time I open a budgeting app, I feel like I need a finance degree just to read it.

So I started thinking about my money like a cup of coffee instead. You can only pour so much in before it overflows. Once I started picturing my paycheck as one cup, "filling it up" with rent, food, and savings before anything extra, budgeting stopped feeling like punishment.

It's not a perfect system. But it's one I actually stick with, and that matters more than a perfect spreadsheet I'll abandon in a week.
